card.name: Rebita
card.tagline: Traditional Angolan couples ballroom dance, ancestor of semba.
card.profile: Rebita (also Massemba) is a traditional Angolan music and dance from Luanda in which a circle of couples, led by a 'commander' (Commandante) who calls directions, dance the umbigada-based Massemba movement, often to bands with concertina/accordion, horns and guitars. It contributed to the development of semba. Massemba was carried by enslaved Africans to Brazil, influencing umbigada, lundu and ultimately samba (English Wikipedia).
card.insight: Angola included Massemba/Rebita within a UNESCO ICH nomination process ('Semba: music and dance in Angola'); the umbigada belly-touch is the shared root linking Rebita to Brazilian samba (English Wikipedia; UNESCO).
